notes:
POC summary: focused on low-latency streaming chat and session-based ranking for homepage personalization. Key points:
- Primary constraint: strict p95 SLO of 300ms for streaming token deltas; customer measures p95 on end-to-end user experience (client->server->stream).
- Observed issues: long-tail latency from ~5% of requests, streaming chunking lag (client sees delayed first token by 120-250ms), occasional rebuffering on multi-region VPC routing.
- SE debug notes: kernel handoff + network jitter contributed; quantized model variants saved ~20-30% latency but increased CPU overhead on some nodes. Batching tuned down to reduce tail, but throughput dropped below target during peak windows.
- Security: LPL requires SSO (SAML), KMS integration for model logs, and explicit EU/NA residency mapping for user PII. Security team requested automated audit logs and 12mo retention policy on logs.
- Commercial: estimated ARR 250-750k with Dedicated reserving one 64-GPU pool; procurement froze budget in Feb citing Q1 cost control.
- Competitive loss: LPL chose vendor that demoed ~250ms p95 using in-house metal-accelerated stack plus edge aggregator. Quote from LPL infra lead: "We need predictable 300ms p95 end-to-end — variability kills it for live recommendations."
- Internal followups: keep technical post-mortem, map mitigations we tested (kv cache, lower batch, quantized fallback, regional egress pinning). Do not pursue aggressive outreach until budget reopens. Suggested touchpoints: security checklist updates, performance micro-benchmarks showing <300ms sustained, and a joint lab with their infra to prove stability.
- Stated next internal owner: none — PM left in Jan; no internal champion identified.
